description: animation.fps wins even when the source file carries delays of its own. Same art and frame order as frame_timing_source_delays, so the two goldens differ only by which timing source was consulted; 6.25 fps is 0.16s a frame, which matches none of the file's 40/120/80/200ms. Without this the precedence is only half pinned -- fps is tested against a file that has no delays to lose to.
